name: claude-default-group
description: Keeps Claude Code tabs in the first editor group and clears editor group locks.

commands.title: Claude Default Group: Move Claude Tabs to First Group
Claude Default Group: Unlock All Editor Groups

claudeDefaultGroup.enabled.description: Move Claude Code tabs into the first editor group when they open, and unlock groups.

claudeDefaultGroup.unlockOnGroupChange.description: Unlock the active editor group whenever editor groups are added, removed or switched.

claudeDefaultGroup.delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after a Claude tab opens before moving it, so Claude Code's own lock lands on the group that is about to be emptied and removed.
